paragraphs: Cumulus sells software that helps community-based care organizations advance whole-person health. Community care hubs, state and regional networks, healthcare partners, and community-based organizations use it to manage referrals, services, programs, partner networks, reporting, and outcomes within one connected platform.

Client intakes are centralized across multiple teams and programs. From there, staff can securely direct referrals, manage client assessments, and track follow-up actions. For community care hubs, the platform handles payer contracts, connects networks of providers, and monitors outcomes. A Veteran Directed Care configuration helps hubs and their partners streamline referrals, centralize veteran documentation, and automate reporting. Another version is tailored to Senior Community Service Employment Program grantees and their subgrantees, covering participant enrollment through performance tracking and payroll.

The platform uses HL7 FHIR standards to bridge gaps between disparate IT systems. The company says it has achieved HITRUST Implemented (e1) Certification. It also states that it works toward ADA and Section 508 accessibility standards.

quote.text: Cumulus deploys quickly, integrates with existing systems, and expands as programs and partner networks evolve.
